description: This file defines the Response class within the Opencart	hiSystem	hiLibrary namespace. It manages HTTP response headers, status, output, and supports features like redirection, compression, and output output. The class is integral to controlling HTTP responses in the OpenCart system.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Class Response manages HTTP response headers, output, redirection, compression, and headers management, integral to HTTP output control in OpenCart.

methods.name: addHeader
methods.description: Adds a header to the internal headers array.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns the array of headers to be sent.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to a specified URL with a given HTTP status code (default 302).

methods.name: setCompression
methods.description: Sets the compression level for output.

methods.name: compress
methods.description: Compresses data using gzip or x-gzip encoding based on server headers and level.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Outputs the response headers and content, applying compression if set.
